METHODS ◆ OCTOBER 22, 2026

On the record.

This website is an opinionated civic document modeled on the cadence of the American Declaration of Independence. It is not a government publication, a legal indictment, or an exhaustive catalog of the administration’s actions.

Each grievance has a concise claim, a dated sequence, and clickable source headlines from identifiable publications or relevant official records. The homepage language is editorial. The detail pages distinguish documented actions from allegations, interpretations, contested responsibility, and legal outcomes where material.

The 37 entries provide 139 linked sources. News reporting and primary records are generally favored; advocacy-group accounts and opinion pieces are identified as such. The chronology marks some publication dates rather than original action dates. Important uncertainty and qualifications remain within the relevant summaries and source material.

Each entry contains an open-license photograph or image with a credit and licensing link. Some images depict the reported event; others illustrate an institution, person, or historical context and are labeled accordingly. Images do not independently substantiate the associated grievance.

Sources were selected and checked as of October 22, 2026. News can change. A link represents a specific report at a specific time, not necessarily the final result of an investigation or lawsuit. External links open their original publisher's pages, which may have paywalls.

The distinction matters: criticism is strongest when the record can be inspected.
